newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Bilbao Vizcaya eyes Brazil banks - paper.
newsitem.headline: Bilbao Vizcaya eyes Brazil banks - paper.

text.p: Spanish bank Banco Bilbao Vizcaya SA is interested in buying Brazilian banks, Gazeta Mercantil financial newspaper said on Friday.
Gazeta said Bilbao, one of the largest banks in Spain, has told Brazil's Central Bank it has $1.0 billion available to purchase of local financial institutions.

The paper also said the Bilbao Vizcaya has already had talks with the Central Bank regarding the privatization of federal bank Banco Meridional, whose tender documents are due to be published in coming days.

Gazeta said Bilbao's interest in Banco Meridional is related to the bank's expansion plans in the Mercosur region. Bilbao recently acquired a controlling stake in Argentina's Banco de Credito Argentino and Banco Frances, the paper said.
